ethnicity_or_population: Nigerian term neonates presenting for routine Plastibell circumcision
technique: Silk suture held at peno-pubic junction and drawn taut to tip of palpable glans with penis 'fully stretching ... without causing discomfort', then applied to a cm ruler; fat-pad depression not described
verbatim_quote: Table 1 'Penile length, PL (cm)' Total: 'Min 2.0', 'Max 5.5', 'Mean(SD) 3.66±0.58'; 'A total of 231 male neonates were recruited for the study but 224 with complete data were analysed.'
notes: Measured at 4-28 days (later than most studies; within minipuberty onset). Abstract gives n=231; analysed n=224 used. Suture method without fat-pad depression.
